node.statement: The maximum formula gives W.K_call>=W.L+1>=W.L, hence W.L*epsilon<=W.K_call*epsilon for epsilon>=0. Also epsilon<=[2*max{1,W.c0_cb*W.K_call}]^(-1); multiplying by the positive W.c0_cb*W.K_call and using W.c0_cb*W.K_call<=max{1,W.c0_cb*W.K_call} gives W.c0_cb*W.K_call*epsilon<=1/2.
